scope: Identification of the CRNDEP Micropeptide by Immunoprecipitation (IP) Followed by MS

The IP experiment was conducted according to Thermo recommendations, using 10 ml of a protein lysate (conc. 11.6 mg/ml), generated with RIPA+inhibitors, from one high-grade ovarian carcinoma (hgOvCa) sample

CRNDEP was then eluted from the resin with 0.1 M glycine, pH = 2 followed by instant neutralization of the sample with 1M TRIS buffer, pH = 8.5, which gave the final IP eluate in the total amount of 3.3 ml.
